problems.detail: issuers: Bank CA; 1 expire within 90 days — renew straight into the new algorithm

problems.title: 1 RSA certificate(s) to reissue

problems.detail: ML-KEM-768 keys/ciphertexts/signatures are much larger than RSA's; handshakes grow by kilobytes
problems.if_ignored: middleboxes that cap ClientHello size drop the new handshakes
problems.mitigation: test through every load balancer, WAF and TLS-inspecting middlebox on the path; check MTU/fragmentation and constrained clients
problems.title: larger keys and signatures on 1 endpoint(s)

parallel_mechanisms.how: offer a hybrid group (classical + ML-KEM-768, e.g. X25519MLKEM768) on TLS 1.3: upgraded peers negotiate it, the rest fall back to the classical group
serve both the RSA and the ML-KEM-768 chain (or a composite certificate) until every relying party trusts the new root
make the algorithm a per-connection setting so each peer and vendor moves on its own date and can be rolled back alone
